note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 45; A06b Const 45; L05 Const 49(1)(b), 49(1)(c)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Eswatini, 2024
sources.said: Person is ordinarily resident for at least 12 months prior to aplication and 5 years during the previous 7 years. ... n.a. ... Person has shown himself by any overt act other than marriage to have acquired another citizenship, or person has by any voluntary act other than marriage acquired another citizenship.
